description: This file contains utility functions for managing symbolic links, copying and wrapping runtime files, and staging plugin runtime overlays and node modules for a build process related to plugin bundling in a project. It primarily handles file system operations for preparing plugin runtime environments.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the type of symbolic link based on the operating system.

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Computes the relative path from target to source for creating symbolic links.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link, recreates it if it already exists and points to the correct target.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Sets up a symbolic link from source to target paths.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if a file should be wrapped as a module, based on .js extension.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be copied directly based on its filename.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper module that re-exports another module.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively stages plugin runtime files by copying, linking, and wrapping files from source to target directory.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link to the source node_modules directory within the plugin runtime directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main function to stage the entire plugin runtime environment, including overlays and node modules, based on project structure.
